lines.en: Platinum scales slip past fallen petals.
I bank slowly along the current.
A petal falls and rests on the water.
I hang beneath the blossom's shadow.
The water mirrors my platinum body.
The blossom grove water is cool and right.

lines.zh: 我停在水底，白鳞朝着你。
lines.en: I hold still on the pond bed, white scales turned toward you.

lines.zh: 你手一动，我就摆尾退开。
lines.en: The moment your hand moves, I flick my tail away.

lines.zh: 花枝底下，我的白金鳞亮着。
lines.en: Under the flowering branch, my platinum scales gleam.

lines.zh: 白金一闪，怪物就不敢来。
lines.en: One platinum flash keeps monsters away.

lines.zh: 白金的鳞，把你照得很清楚。
lines.en: My platinum scales show you quite clearly.
I lift my head toward you on the bank.
You crushed petals by the water's edge.
Your shadow rides the ripples closer.
You are no fish. I do not fear you.
You crouch down and I come nearer.

lines.zh: 河底的石子被你看清了。
lines.en: You can see the stones of my riverbed.

lines.zh: 水面映出你的脸，我浮着不动。
lines.en: The water mirrors your face while I float motionless.
I can't hold on much longer...

lines.zh: 白金鳞片被刮花了一块。
lines.en: A patch of my platinum scales is scratched.
The pain makes it hard to breathe...

lines.zh: 白鳞掉了两片，沉到池底。
lines.en: Two white scales come loose and sink to the pond bed.

lines.zh: 水面漂着碎果，我游过去闻。
lines.en: Crushed fruit floats on the water; I swim over to sniff it.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片像一整块白金。
lines.en: My scales shine like one platinum sheet.

lines.zh: 享受这宁静吧，然后消失。
白金鳞片一翻，你就跑不掉。
lines.en: One flip of platinum scales and you cannot flee.
You know what I taste like.
Get close, and you'll be surprised.
This is my territory, got it?

lines.zh: 银白的鳞被你踢得乱闪。
lines.en: Your kick scatters flashes across my silver scales.
Hit me, and you'll regret it!
Silver scales grazed your leg; cold, yes?
The brightest in the pond is me.

lines.zh: 两尾白金绕着荷叶慢慢转。
lines.en: Two platinum koi circle the lily pad, slowly.

lines.zh: 白金的光绕着你转，跟我来吧。
lines.en: My platinum shine circles you; come along.
I don’t like the smell here.

lines.zh: 这片水草够密，我钻进去歇。
lines.en: This patch of waterweed is dense enough; I slip in to rest.

lines.zh: 有东西踩进水里，白鳞一转。
lines.en: Something steps into the water, and my white scales turn.

lines.zh: 我游过来，水面像铺了层银。
lines.en: I swim over, laying silver on the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着池底的卵石往前游。
lines.en: I glide forward along the pebbles on the pond bed.

lines.zh: 白金的光，在水底替我照着。
lines.en: Platinum light lights the riverbed for me.
One flash of white scales — this pond is mine.

lines.zh: 白金的鳞一摆，水就亮了。
lines.en: One flick of platinum scales lights the water.
Something small moves under the water.
An insect fell into the blossom shade.
I taste the scent of waterweed.
I keep watch over these waters.
Who is thrashing in my water?
I circle that patch of shade.

lines.zh: 花瓣的影子里，我盯住那一点。
lines.en: In the shadow of the petals, I fix on that one point.

lines.zh: 白金的鳞把光聚在它身上。
lines.en: My platinum scales gather the light onto it.

lines.zh: 白金鳞片把你的光打回去。
lines.en: My platinum scales throw your light back.

lines.zh: 它的波纹每动一次，我修正一次。
lines.en: Every ripple it makes, I correct my aim.

lines.zh: 我悬在它上方，尾巴轻轻摆。
lines.en: I hang above it, tail swaying gently.
I press close to the waterweed.
I hold still and wait for it.
The ripples give away its place.
It has not noticed my shining scales.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，你逃不出我的范围！
lines.en: Sssss, you can't escape my range!

lines.zh: 我没有爪子，只有甩起来的尾巴。
lines.en: I have no claws, only a tail I can whip around.

lines.zh: 白金鳞片映着花瓣的光。
lines.en: My platinum scales catch the blossom light.
One flick of my tail and water sprays.
I butt aside the clump of weed.
My scales scrape out a thin water sound.
I open my mouth and take in water.
A flash of platinum churns the surface.
I push the thing toward the bank.
A flash of platinum light under the water.
My platinum pattern shines on the water.
Here I am, prepare for me!
The platinum koi drops into the water.
I wake in the blossom grove's water.
A splash, and there I am.
My scales light up the pond.
This water is mine to guard now.
I swim out from under the blossoms.
No monster comes near this water.
I appear in the shallow water.

lines.zh: 鳞片被撕裂了...，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My scales are torn — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我的白鳞翻了过来。
lines.en: The blast tears the water open and flips my white scales over.
A scratch on my platinum scales.

lines.zh: 我游得越来越慢...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm swimming slower — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷落进池子，白金鳞全翻起来。
lines.en: Lightning hit the pond; my platinum scales flared.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，白鳞失了光。
lines.en: There is no water in the void, and my white scales lose their shine.
